name: appit-skills
description: Practical agent skills for real engineering work: browser QA, tickets, databases, remote boxes, CI triage, Blender.

plugins.name: live-qa
plugins.description: Step-by-step live QA in a real browser: numbered screenshot per step, pass/fail table, console/network/a11y evidence.

plugins.name: trello-tickets
plugins.description: Create and read Trello cards from seven baked-in ticket types with sections, checklist, labels and cover color.

plugins.name: repo-runbook
plugins.description: Generate and keep a short verified runbook (install/run/test/migrate) in AGENTS.md so later sessions stop re-discovering it.

plugins.name: pg-inspect
plugins.description: Read-only Postgres inspection: tables, schema, SELECT, EXPLAIN, migrations, locks, sizes — safe against production.

plugins.name: remote-exec
plugins.description: One-shot SSH for agents: aliased hosts, hard timeouts, no password-prompt hangs, single-call host probe.

plugins.name: cloud-browser
plugins.description: Hosted/stealth cloud browser sessions through agent-browser providers, plus the sweep that stops orphaned browsers.

plugins.name: ci-triage
plugins.description: One command from "CI is red" to the failing step and the extracted error, for GitHub Actions and GitLab CI.

plugins.name: open-design
plugins.description: Work in the OpenDesign monorepo: pinned pnpm, tools-dev lifecycle, desktop/browser QA, pre-PR checks.

plugins.name: blender-pipeline
plugins.description: Blockout to shade to light to export in Blender via MCP, with eight specialist playbooks behind one router.
